description: This file contains a shell script that performs testing of shared repository initialization features for Git, including permission settings, configurations, and hooks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test scenario with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests Git configuration variables.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_modebits
methods.description: Checks the permission bits of files.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the testing timestamp for tests that depend on time.
